name: 73119 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73119 (Oklahoma City) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73119 (Oklahoma City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73119 (Oklahoma City) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
